data_description.host: The hostname or IP address of your Nanoleaf device.

link.title: Link Nanoleaf
link.description: Press and hold the power button on your Nanoleaf for 5 seconds until the button LEDs start flashing, then select **Submit** within 30 seconds.

error.not_allowing_new_tokens: Nanoleaf is not allowing new tokens, follow the instructions above.

no_panels.message: This Nanoleaf device does not expose individually addressable panels.

unknown_panels.message: Unknown panel ID(s): {panels}. Valid panel IDs are: {valid}.

set_all_panels.name: Set all panels
set_all_panels.description: Sets every panel of a Nanoleaf panel device to a single color as a static scene.

rgb_color.name: Color
rgb_color.description: The RGB color to apply to all panels.

brightness.name: Brightness
brightness.description: Optional brightness overlay applied to the color (0-100%).

set_panel_colors.name: Set panel colors
set_panel_colors.description: Sets individual panel colors as a static scene. Panels that are not listed are turned off.

panels.name: Panels
panels.description: A list of items, each with a panel_id and an rgb_color.

brightness.name: Brightness
brightness.description: Optional brightness overlay applied to the colors (0-100%).

blink_panels.name: Blink panels
blink_panels.description: Briefly shows a color on all panels, then restores the previously selected effect.

rgb_color.name: Color
rgb_color.description: The RGB color to flash on all panels.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to show the color before restoring, in seconds.

brightness.name: Brightness
brightness.description: Optional brightness overlay applied to the color (0-100%).

deprecated_device_trigger.title: Nanoleaf device trigger is deprecated
deprecated_device_trigger.description: The Nanoleaf device trigger is deprecated and will be removed in a future release. You can now use the gesture event entity to build automations.
